column1: # Digest of a request (М10/8 Н1.5 `digest`, Н3 «подать просьбу» шаг 1): the vectors of their own (ADR-0083, stage A).
# Owner: «Спецификация»; lesson-owner М10/8; participants console (a request filed at the door) and <s>worker (filed by a
# worker, worker.requests). The product's conformance — its own acceptance against this table (ADR-0080 доп. 16).
# A client's digest: sha256 of JCS (RFC 8785, ADR-0072) of the client's body after the schema, without valid_until — the
# one server field a client may send; unit is in it. A worker's digest: sha256 of JCS of the object made of the row's
# body fields as written (text), without unit, valid_until, the stamps (by, at, group, the about field) and filed.
# The two are not compared with each other: a repeat is told apart by the digest of its own kind (Н1.5).
# Columns, tab-separated, one row a line; a line that begins with '#' and an empty line are no row:
#   input      client — the body as sent, JSON text; worker — the row's items as written, a JSON object of strings
#   canonical  the JCS text that is hashed (the normalized input)
#   sha256     hex of the canonical text's UTF-8
#   note       why the row is here

column5: base: the client body, unit included
valid_until — the one server field a client may send — is not hashed
nested object: keys sorted, 2.50 is 2.5, null inside stays
small and large numbers in ES6 form: 1e-7, 1e+21
UTF-8 as is, U+2028 raw, no HTML escaping
keys by UTF-16 code units: U+1F600 before U+FB33
base: the row's body fields as written (text), unit dropped
valid_until, stamps (by, at, group, the about field — of at testsub2) and filed are not hashed
values stay text: "5" is a string, not the number 5
a json field's text is a string as written, not parsed again
